mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and corporate earnings pressure, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in private sector employment (PAYEMS) and decline in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates labor market overheating that triggers inflationary pressures and Federal Reserve tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of PAYEMS rising and RSAFS falling does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime with high housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11500), the S&P 500 underperforms due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 > 11500), SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declined over the prior month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) and decline in private sector employment growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5%) signals dual shock of monetary tightening and labor weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS rising and PAYEMS growth declining does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a stagflationary regime with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and weak industrial production (INDPRO < 110), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: In stagflationary regime (CPIAUCSL > 215 and INDPRO < 110), SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
